_comment: The single source of truth for every measured figure this repository publishes. docs/stats.md is generated from this file end to end, and every figure quoted in README.md, docs/conformance-gaps.md, docs/testing.md and docs/todo.md is a generated region fed from it; do not edit those regions by hand. Suite counts are recorded here because a suite run costs minutes: re-measure with tests/check.sh, copy the passing counts here with the run date and command, then run `go run tests/conformance-docs.go`. Counts derived from the source tree are NOT recorded here -- only their counting method is -- because a number typed into a data file is the same defect as a number typed into a sentence.

suites.unenumerated_note: The balance want an XTSE3430 refusal that only the unwritten remainder of the §19.8 posture-and-sweep analysis can emit. §19.1 does not require a non-streaming processor to assess guaranteed-streamability, so they are read as a block under "The §19.8 streamability analysis" rather than case by case. su-ascent-902 belongs to that block and is ALSO enumerated above, because its verdict is not the block's: the analysis does reach it, and the rule the test asserts contradicts §19.8.5.7's own worked example. It is counted once, in the breakdown of 14, so the enumeration and the breakdown overlap by exactly that one case and 20 + 14 = 34. merge-097sf was enumerated here until 2026-09-11 and is not a disagreement at all: it declares the streaming-fallback feature, which this engine does not claim, so the harness skips it.

Recorded set by set rather than case by case: 22 of the 30 are MS-Regex2006-07-15 under the same open W3C bug 4113, and the balance are assorted queried/stable expectations across the Microsoft-contributed sets. The per-set breakdown is the hand-written table under "xsd".
As for 1.0: 22 MS-Regex2006-07-15 cases under bug 4113 and 9 assorted challenged expectations.
